definition: a round shape with a hole in the middle
description: A man in swim shorts stands at the edge of a garden pool holding a folded towel and smiling at the camera. In the pool a golden retriever puppy floats with its head and front paws resting through a bright pink inflatable ring. A grey pitbull drifts past in a red one, and the camera returns to the puppy dozing in the pink ring.
transcript: Three, two, one. Lucas, Rocky, Gumbo.
